mentions.name: Upfront
mentions.description: A customer support platform that unifies the basic requirements of customer support which are typically split across multiple per-user-priced tools, giving everyone in a small team visibility into what is being communicated to customers.
mentions.problem: The basic requirements of a customer support platform are split across multiple tools and all priced per-user, forcing small teams to limit who in the org has visibility into customer communications.
mentions.audience: Small B2B startup teams where not everyone can afford per-user support tool licenses
mentions.source_excerpt: I set out to solve that with https://stayupfront.com and now that the build is in a good place i’m finally having to bite the bullet and learn marketing.

evidence.value: I set out to solve that with https://stayupfront.com and now that the build is in a good place i’m finally having to bite the bullet and learn marketing.
